extracted.intended_audience: state, local, and Indian tribal governments; education administrators and entities governed by OMB Circular A-87
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for documenting and supporting salaries and related costs under U.S. Department of Education programs for entities governed by OMB Circular A-87, including permissible recordkeeping methods, standards, alternatives, and compliance consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / Applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Directed to state, local and Indian tribal governments; pertains to programs of the U.S. Department of Education for entities governed by OMB Circular A-87.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies which entities and programs the guidelines apply to (entities governed by OMB Circular A-87 and Department of Education programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexibility and certainty in meeting federal time distribution recordkeeping requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: New guidelines to provide more flexibility and certainty in meeting federal time distribution recordkeeping requirements for U.S. Department of Education programs are outlined in this document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidelines are intended to reduce burdens of rigid recordkeeping while clarifying acceptable practices so entities can reliably demonstrate compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payroll documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: The guidelines pertain to payroll documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes expectations for payroll records that support salary charges to federal programs (accuracy, retention, and sufficiency to demonstrate time worked on program activities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Time distribution records
rubrics_metrics.description: The guidelines pertain to time distribution records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines what constitutes acceptable time distribution documentation showing employees' allocation of time across activities and funding sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for time distribution records
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for time distribution records are specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the criteria and level of detail required in time distribution records (format, substantiation, periodicity, and clarity needed to support charges).

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute systems for meeting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on substitute systems for meeting requirements is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows alternative recordkeeping systems (substitute systems) that meet the standards and intent of the regulations when standard time distribution records are impractical; explains acceptable alternatives and conditions for their use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written requests for guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for written requests for guidance are included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes how entities may request formal guidance or determinations in writing regarding acceptable recordkeeping practices or substitute systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional standards are addressed as part of the guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires application of appropriate professional judgment and standards in preparing and certifying payroll and time distribution records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences of failure to meet requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Consequences of failure to meet requirements are described.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains potential outcomes for noncompliance (audit findings, appeals, disputes, and possible disallowance of costs) and encourages practices that avoid such consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuing review
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuing review of compliance is part of the guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires ongoing monitoring and review mechanisms to ensure continued adherence to recordkeeping standards and prompt correction of deficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goals: avoid audit appeals and disputes; encourage efficient use of resources; maintain accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: The guidelines are expected to avoid audit appeals and disputes, free teachers and administrators to educate, and encourage the creative use of resources from different federal, state, and local programs while maintaining accountability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes balancing reduced administrative burden with accountability—minimizing time spent tabulating/litigating and enabling creative programmatic resource use without sacrificing compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date / immediate effect
rubrics_metrics.description: The guidelines are effective on issuance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that the policy changes apply immediately upon release and should be implemented without delay.
